title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Manipulating the Securities and Futures Markets

articles.content_en: Article 6 Where an actor commits the act of manipulating securities or futures markets on two or more occasions, and such acts are subject to administrative or criminal handling according to law but have not been handled, the relevant transaction amounts or illegal gains shall be calculated cumulatively.

Article 7 Where the actor meets the criteria provided in Articles 2 and 3 of this Interpretation, truthfully confesses the criminal facts, admits guilt and expresses remorse, actively cooperates with the investigation, and returns the illegal gains, he or she may be given a light punishment; where the circumstances of the crime are minor, he or she may, according to law, not be prosecuted or be granted exemption from criminal punishment.
Where the scope and conditions for applying leniency based on admission of guilt and acceptance of punishment as provided in the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China are met, the case shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 8 Where a unit commits an act under Paragraph 1 of Article 182 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the directly responsible supervisors and other directly responsible persons shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the standards for conviction and sentencing provided in this Interpretation, and the unit shall be fined.

Article 9 For the purposes of this Interpretation, "illegal gains" means the benefits obtained or losses avoided through manipulating securities or futures markets.
For the purposes of this Interpretation, "ten consecutive trading days" means ten consecutive trading days when the securities or futures markets are open for trading, and does not mean ten consecutive trading days when the actor engages in trading.

Article 10 For acts of manipulating the securities market carried out in the National Equities Exchange and Quotations system, if such acts cause substantial social harm and seriously undermine fair and just market order, they shall be dealt with by reference to the provisions of this Interpretation, except for Items (1) and (2) of Article 2 and Items (1) and (2) of Article 4 of this Interpretation.
Article 11 This Interpretation shall come into force on July 1, 2019.
